text: Phase column: don't scroll when the selected phase is deleted
description: From Felix's note "after deleting a phase, the parent column scrolling behaved weirdly". A deletion reaches clients as pushes: the owner stops listing the phase (held as in-transit), then it is removed. At that point the selection falls back to the first entry until the delete action reselects the neighbour. Column.vue treated the fallback as navigation and smooth-scrolled toward the top, then back. Also, settledSelection was null until the watch first fired, so a freshly mounted column judged its first change without a baseline. Fix: seed it on mount, and treat "previous entry vanished" as not navigation.

status.comment: Implemented; new Column.spec.ts (component test, jsdom) fails without the fix and passes with it; 249/249 frontend tests, vue-tsc clean. Not reproduced live because that would mean deleting a phase in Felix's real graph. Felix: delete a phase and watch its column.
